name: forest-breath-meditation
description: 3-minute 4K cinematic breathing meditation video built with Remotion

scripts.render: node scripts/check-assets.mjs && remotion render ForestBreath out/forest-breath-4k.mp4
scripts.ambience: python3 scripts/generate-ambience.py out/forest-ambience.wav && ffmpeg -y -i out/forest-ambience.wav -c:a aac -b:a 256k -movflags +faststart public/audio/forest-ambience.m4a
